LightningComponentBundle.description: Configurable detail section. Build its configuration in the Section Config Builder (/lightning/n/ND_Section_Config_Builder) and paste the result into Field JSON Configuration.

property.name: ND_jsonConfigString
property.label: Field JSON Configuration
property.description: BUILD THIS AT /lightning/n/ND_Section_Config_Builder — the Section Config Builder composes this whole value visually: field rows, section title, icon picker, colour pickers, layout, header alert, plus a live preview of this component and validation that catches misspelled keys. Build it there, click Copy JSON, paste it here. It supersedes every other property on this panel. Hand-editing works but is unvalidated: a mistyped key does nothing and reports nothing on the page, only to the browser console.

property.name: ND_sectionTitle
property.label: z. Title (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. Set the title in the Section Config Builder instead; it writes it into Field JSON Configuration. Still read only when the JSON does not set a title. Kept because the platform will not let a property be removed while the component is on a page.

property.name: ND_iconName
property.label: z. Icon Name (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. The Config Builder has an icon picker with a live preview. Still read only when the JSON does not set an icon.

property.name: ND_headerBackgroundColor
property.label: z. Header Background Color (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. The Config Builder has a colour picker. Still read only when the JSON does not set a header colour.

property.name: ND_headerTextColor
property.label: z. Header Text Color (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. The Config Builder has a colour picker. Still read only when the JSON does not set a header text colour.

property.name: ND_startCollapsed
property.label: z. Collapse by Default (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. Set this in the Config Builder's Section panel. Still read only when the JSON does not set it.

property.name: ND_layoutType
property.label: z. Layout (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. Set the column count in the Config Builder's Section panel. Still read only when the JSON does not set it.

property.name: ND_headerLogicField
property.label: z. Dynamic Header: Trigger Field (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. The Config Builder's Section panel configures the header alert with a field picker and colour pickers. Still read only when the JSON does not set it.

property.name: ND_headerLogicValue
property.label: z. Dynamic Header: Trigger Value (legacy — use the Config Builder)

property.name: ND_headerActiveColor
property.label: z. Dynamic Header: Active BG Color (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. See the Config Builder's Section panel. Still read only when the JSON does not set it.

property.name: ND_headerActiveTextColor
property.label: z. Dynamic Header: Active Text Color (legacy — use the Config Builder)
property.description: SUPERSEDED. See the Config Builder's Section panel. Still read only when the JSON does not set it.

property.name: ND_showConfigDiagnostics
property.label: z. Show Config Diagnostics (no longer used)
property.description: NO LONGER USED. The component ignores this. Validation now happens in the Section Config Builder before anything is pasted, and problems on a live page are written to the browser console. Declared only because the platform will not let a property be removed while the component is on a page.
